description: Update A/B test settings. Campaign tests use testPercentage, testDurationMinutes, and winnerCriteria. During testing, duration is total minutes from the original start, or from when the last test email is due when delivery is spread (a past deadline selects immediately), and audience changes queue a resize that preserves committed sends. Read pendingSampleUpdate and progress using get_ab_test; retry the same percentage after failure or discard a failed request with cancelSampleUpdate. endTestNow ends a running campaign test early: the winner is picked by its criteria from the results so far and sent to the rest of the audience. The winning metric stays fixed once testing starts. Sequence tests use testType, winnerThreshold, winnerCriteria, and autoSelectWinner; changing live or already-used sequence settings requires confirmLiveChange. Provide at least one setting.

autoSelectWinner.description: Sequence-only. true picks the leading variant once winnerThreshold is reached (the default); false keeps splitting contacts until select_ab_test_winner. Turning it on can pick a winner on the next send if the threshold is already reached. resume_ab_test sets it to false.

cancelSampleUpdate.description: Discard a failed campaign sample change. Cannot be combined with testPercentage.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

confirmLiveChange.description: Required as true when sequence settings affect an active test or a test with recorded activity.

endTestNow.description: End a running campaign test now and pick the winner by its criteria, instead of waiting for testDurationMinutes. Needs the campaigns:send permission. Cannot be combined with testDurationMinutes.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Optional timestamp from get_ab_test. Rejects a change if settings have since changed.

testDurationMinutes.description: Campaign-only test duration in minutes, from 15 to 1440.

testPercentage.description: Campaign-only percentage of the audience used for the test phase, from 5 to 50.

testType.description: Sequence-only variant strategy. When winnerCriteria is omitted, subject defaults to open_rate and content defaults to click_rate.

winnerCriteria.description: Winner selection criteria. Applies to both campaign and sequence tests and is locked once a campaign test starts. goal_conversion_rate picks the variant whose recipients convert on winnerGoalId most often, goal_value the one with the most goal value per delivered email (use winnerGoalId "default-revenue" for purchase revenue), and event_rate the one whose recipients most often fire winnerEventName after receiving it. Conversions count when attributed to the email (an open or click within the goal's window; for campaigns, revenue and campaign goals also credit a recipient who received the email in that window). When no variant converts, campaign tests fall back to click rate and sequence tests keep splitting.

winnerEventName.description: Event judged by event_rate, such as "trial.converted". Required for event_rate.

winnerGoalId.description: Goal judged by goal_conversion_rate or goal_value: a goal ID (company-wide, or scoped to this campaign or sequence) or "default-revenue" for built-in purchase revenue. Required for those criteria.

winnerThreshold.description: Sequence-only number of recipients before selecting a winner, from 10 to 1000.
